about.title: About Us & Location
about.subtitle: Learn more about Pousada Monte Alto and the Brazilian Caribbean
about.story1: Pousada Monte Alto was born from the dream of creating a welcoming, family-run guesthouse close to nature in one of the most peaceful spots in Rio de Janeiro's Lakes Region.
about.story2: Located in Monte Alto, our setting is a true sanctuary: beachfront to the ocean and 3 minutes from the romantic sunset at Araruama Lagoon.
about.beach1Desc: Beachfront right in front of the pousada. Endless white sand, clean water and great for kitesurfing.
about.beach2Desc: 3 minutes away. Calm waters with the most breathtaking sunset in Arraial do Cabo.
about.beach3Desc: 10-12 min drive. Bustling promenade, restaurants and ocean sunsets.
about.beach4Desc: 15 min drive. Departure point for famous boat trips to Lighthouse Island.
about.beach5Desc: 20 min drive. Famous wooden staircases and surreal turquoise water.
about.beach6Desc: 18 min drive + scenic easy trail. Calm bay rich in sea turtles.
